objective_comparison.suggested_caption: paired per-case difference from the same no-consistency comparator, on the validation cohort. Points are cases, squares are means with 95\% intervals, and the fraction at the right of each row is the number of cases favouring that arm.

supervision_scale.suggested_caption: Per-case scores with cohort means and 95\% intervals. The shaded rows are supervised SCALE REFERENCES. They differ from the semi-supervised arms in labelled-case count, fold membership and training protocol at once, so the distance to them is not a label-efficiency measurement and no equivalence is claimed.
